steps.text: Bring a pick and a rope.
Go down into the Thais sewers near the depot.
steps.source: Enter the Thais Sewers near the depot. You will face Rats here.

steps.text: Go to the south-west end of the sewers and use your pick 2 squares north of the dead end on the east side. Go down the hole.
steps.source: Navigate to the south-west end of the cave (Mapper Coords 126.46, 126.1, 8). Use a pick on the tile 2 sqm north of the dead end on the eastern side. A hole should open.
